items.title: ATP: The Energy Currency of Cells (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: ATP: The Energy Currency of Cells, printed pages 141-142 (PDF 144-145); a main subheading of Bioenergetics and ATP: the energy currency of cells, its own page as in Computer Science (owner 2026-11-04).

blocks.text: Cells apne reactions ke liye tawanai ki ek khaas currency (sikka) istemal karte hain. Yeh currency asal mein ek nucleotide hai jise adenosine triphosphate (ATP) kehte hain. Jab cells ko tawanai jama karni ho to woh ATP banate hain, aur jab tawanai chahiye ho to ATP torte hain. ATP ke molecule ke teen hisse hain: adenine (nitrogen wala base), ribose (paanch carbon wali sugar) aur teen phosphate groups.

blocks.alt: Teen phosphate groups (P likhe daire) ek qatar mein, jo lehredar lakeeron se jure hain jin par Energy bonds likha hai; teesra phosphate ek panch-kone (pentagon) Ribose se jura hai, aur ribose ek jure hue paanch aur chhe kone wale dohre chhalle (ring) Adenine se. Rang dar patti aur do-rukhe teer Adenosine (adenine aur ribose), Adenosine monophosphate (AMP), Adenosine diphosphate (ADP) aur Adenosine triphosphate (ATP) ki hadd dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.1: ATP ki molecular banawat (kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Daen (right) se shuru karein: adenine aur ribose mil kar adenosine banate hain. Is mein ek phosphate jure to AMP, do jurein to ADP, aur teen jurein to ATP. Lehredar lakeerein (energy bonds) aakhri do phosphates ke darmiyan high-energy bonds hain; in mein se ek toote to tawanai (energy) nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Daryaft
blocks.text: ATP 1929 mein Karl Lohmann ne daryaft kiya. 1941 mein Nobel inaam yafta Fritz Lipmann ne tajweez kiya ke ATP cell mein tawanai muntaqil karne wala bunyadi molecule hai.

Do phosphates ke darmiyan wale covalent bonds high-energy bonds (zyada tawanai wale bonds) hain. Jab in mein se ek bond toot-ta hai to inorganic phosphate (Pi) alag ho jata hai aur tawanai nikalti hai. Ek phosphate bond tootne se ATP ke har mole se taqreeban 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) tawanai milti hai.

blocks.text_alt: ATP + H₂O → ADP + Pᵢ + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)

blocks.text: Aam tawanai wale reactions mein sirf bahar wala (outer) P-P high-energy bond toot-ta hai. Aisa hone par ATP, ADP (adenosine diphosphate) ban jata hai aur ek Pi alag hota hai.
Kuch soorton mein ADP mazeed toot kar AMP (adenosine monophosphate) aur Pi ban jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: ADP + H₂O → AMP + Pᵢ + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: ATP mein teen phosphate, ADP mein do, AMP mein ek. Har dafa ek phosphate (Pi) alag hone par taqreeban 7.3 kcal fi mole tawanai milti hai, aur is ke liye pani (H₂O) istemal hota hai.

Cells khuraak ke oxidation se tawanai hasil karte hain aur yeh tawanai ADP ko Pi se jor kar ATP ki shakal mein jama karte hain. Khulasa yeh ke tawanai chhorne wale amal ke dauran ATP banta hai aur tawanai kharch karne wale amal ke dauran ATP toot-ta hai. Is tarah ATP ek metabolic reaction se doosre tak tawanai pohanchata (transfer karta) hai.

blocks.alt: Baen (left) neeli gend ATP aur daen hari gend ADP ke darmiyan ek chakkar (cycle). Upar ka teer, Formation of ATP, ADP se ATP ki taraf hai aur is mein Energy aur Pi dakhil hote hain. Neeche ka teer, Breakdown of ATP, ATP se ADP ki taraf hai; is mein Water dakhil hota hai aur Pi aur Energy bahar nikalte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.2: ATP-ADP cycle (kitab ki Figure 5.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar: khuraak ke oxidation se mili tawanai ADP ko Pi se jor kar ATP banati hai (tawanai zakheera). Neeche: paani ATP ka aakhri bond torta hai (hydrolysis), Pi alag hota hai aur tawanai kaam ke liye milti hai. Yeh chakkar cell mein lagataar chalta rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: ATP ko tawanai ka zakheera nahin balke currency kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Paise ki tarah ATP der tak rakha nahin jata balke ek amal se doosre tak guzarta hai: khuraak ke oxidation jaise tawanai chhorne wale reactions ADP aur Pi jor kar tawanai jama karte hain, aur tawanai kharch karne wale reactions high-energy phosphate bond tor kar use kharch karte hain. Yeh tawanai zakheera karne ki bajaye muntaqil karta hai.

items: Bioenergetics zinda nizamon mein tawanai ke bahao ka mutala hai; photosynthesis tawanai pakarti hai aur respiration chhorti hai. Zindagi ki taqreeban tamam tawanai photosynthesis se aati hai.
ATP (Lohmann 1929; Lipmann 1941) = adenine + ribose + teen phosphates; aakhri P-P bonds high-energy hain. ATP + H₂O → ADP + Pᵢ + 7.3 kcal fi mole; ADP aage AMP ban sakta hai.
ATP khuraak ke oxidation se banta hai (ADP + Pi) aur tawanai chahiye ho to toot-ta hai: is liye ATP cell ki tawanai ki currency hai.
